title: Matchmaking queue publisher and consumer with tracing
name: Matchmaking request pipeline

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code propagates and records distributed traces across the queue? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
In EnqueueAsync, why is MatchmakingTelemetry.Inject called with the activity started by StartActivity rather than relying on Activity.Current at publish time inside the bus?
choices: The bus runs on another thread, so Activity.Current is always null there
The headers are built before PublishAsync is awaited, so the injected traceparent identifies the producer span, which becomes the parent of the consumer side
Inject needs a Dictionary and cannot read Activity.Current
StartActivity only records the span if Inject has been called on it

questions.prompt: In ProcessOneAsync, a pool call throws an InvalidOperationException. What does the trace and the caller see?
choices: The place_request span is marked Error with the message, a warning is logged, and the method returns false so the batch continues
The exception propagates, the batch stops, and the place_request span is left unfinished
The exception is logged and the span is marked Ok because the exception was handled
Only the batch span is marked Error, and the place_request span has no status

questions.prompt: A caller cancels the token while TryPlaceAsync is awaiting. How does this code treat the cancellation?
choices: It is logged as a warning and the message counts as not placed
It is recorded as an Error span and swallowed, so the remaining messages are still processed
It is rethrown by its own catch block, so it is not turned into a logged failure, and the using declarations still end the spans
It is converted into a TimeoutException before leaving ProcessOneAsync
